items.title: Ellie and the Red Ball
parts: Ellie the little elephant found a red ball by the river.
She rolled it to Monkey. Monkey rolled it back.
Soon all the animals were playing together. Ellie smiled a big elephant smile.

items.title: The Paper Boat
parts: Aarav folded a paper boat on a rainy morning.
With his grandmother, he set it on a puddle near the door. It bobbed and spun.
A leaf floated next to it like a tiny friend. The two drifted side by side.
When the rain stopped, the boat rested on the grass, ready for the next rainy day.
